<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="pt-BR">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Roleta PRO</title>

<style>

body{
  margin:0;
  background:#0f172a;
  color:white;
  font-family:Arial;
  overflow-x:hidden;
}

.container{
  max-width:1300px;
  margin:auto;
  padding:20px;
}

h1{
  text-align:center;
  font-size:42px;
  margin-bottom:20px;
}

.layout{
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:380px 1fr;
  gap:25px;
}

.panel{
  background:#1e293b;
  border-radius:20px;
  padding:20px;
  box-shadow:0 0 20px rgba(0,0,0,0.5);
}

.item{
  display:flex;
  gap:8px;
  margin-bottom:10px;
}

input,select{
  width:100%;
  border:none;
  border-radius:10px;
  padding:10px;
  font-size:15px;
}

button{
  border:none;
  border-radius:12px;
  padding:12px 18px;
  cursor:pointer;
  font-weight:bold;
  transition:0.2s;
}

button:hover{
  transform:scale(1.04);
}

.green{
  background:#10b981;
  color:white;
}

.red{
  background:#ef4444;
  color:white;
}

.blue{
  background:#3b82f6;
  color:white;
}

.gold{
  background:#f59e0b;
  color:black;
}

.controls{
  display:flex;
  flex-wrap:wrap;
  gap:10px;
  margin-top:15px;
}

.wheel-area{
  display:flex;
  flex-direction:column;
  align-items:center;
}

.pointer{
  width:0;
  height:0;
  border-left:22px solid transparent;
  border-right:22px solid transparent;
  border-top:40px solid gold;
  z-index:10;
  margin-bottom:-10px;
}

canvas{
  background:white;
  border-radius:50%;
  box-shadow:0 0 30px rgba(255,255,255,0.2);
}

.result{
  margin-top:20px;
  font-size:34px;
  font-weight:bold;
  color:gold;
  text-align:center;
  min-height:50px;
}

.history{
  margin-top:20px;
  background:#111827;
  border-radius:15px;
  padding:15px;
  width:100%;
  max-height:200px;
  overflow:auto;
}

.history h3{
  margin-top:0;
}

.entry{
  padding:6px;
  border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
}

.stats{
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);
  gap:10px;
  margin-top:20px;
}

.stat{

  padding:15px;

}

.light{

  width:12px;

<body>

<div class="container">

<h1>🎰 ROLETA PRO</h1>

<div class="layout">

<div class="panel">

<h2>Configurações</h2>

<div id="items"></div>

<div class="controls">
<button class="green" onclick="addItem()">+ Adicionar</button>
<button class="blue" onclick="spinWheel()">🎯 Girar</button>
<button class="gold" onclick="autoSpin()">⚡ Auto Giro</button>
</div>

<hr>

<h3>Velocidade</h3>

<select id="speed">
<option value="3000">Rápida</option>
<option value="5000" selected>Média</option>
<option value="8000">Lenta</option>
</select>

<h3>Moedas</h3>
<input type="number" id="coins" value="1000">

<div class="stats">

<div class="stat">
<h2 id="wins">0</h2>
<div>Vitórias</div>
</div>

<div class="stat">
<h2 id="spins">0</h2>
<div>Giros</div>
</div>

</div>

</div>

<div class="wheel-area">

<div class="pointer"></div>

<canvas id="wheel" width="500" height="500"></canvas>

<div class="result" id="result">
Clique em GIRAR
</div>

<div class="history">
<h3>📜 Histórico</h3>
<div id="history"></div>
</div>

</div>

</div>

</div>

<audio id="tick">
<source src="https://actions.google.com/sounds/v1/clicks/click.ogg">
</audio>

<audio id="win">
<source src="https://actions.google.com/sounds/v1/cartoon/concussive_hit_guitar_boing.ogg">
</audio>

<script>

const canvas = document.getElementById("wheel");
const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");

let options = [
{name:"Comum",chance:50},
{name:"Raro",chance:30},
{name:"Épico",chance:15},
{name:"Lendário",chance:5}
];

let currentRotation = 0;
let spinning = false;
let totalSpins = 0;
let totalWins = 0;

function color(i){
  return `hsl(${i*75},75%,55%)`;
}

function renderInputs(){

  const div = document.getElementById("items");
  div.innerHTML = "";

  options.forEach((o,i)=>{

    div.innerHTML += `
    <div class="item">

      <input
      value="${o.name}"
      onchange="updateName(${i},this.value)"
      >

      <input
      type="number"
      value="${o.chance}"
      onchange="updateChance(${i},this.value)"
      >

      <button class="red" onclick="removeItem(${i})">
      X
      </button>

    </div>
    `;

  });

}

function updateName(i,v){
  options[i].name=v;
  drawWheel(currentRotation);
}

function updateChance(i,v){
  options[i].chance=Number(v);
  drawWheel(currentRotation);
}

function addItem(){

  options.push({
    name:"Nova",
    chance:10
  });

  renderInputs();
  drawWheel(currentRotation);

}

function removeItem(i){

  options.splice(i,1);

  renderInputs();
  drawWheel(currentRotation);

}

function drawWheel(rotation=0){

  ctx.clearRect(0,0,500,500);

  const total =
  options.reduce((s,o)=>s+o.chance,0);

  let start = rotation;

  options.forEach((o,i)=>{

    const slice =
    (o.chance/total)*Math.PI*2;

    ctx.beginPath();

    ctx.moveTo(250,250);

    ctx.arc(
      250,
      250,
      220,
      start,
      start+slice
    );

    ctx.fillStyle=color(i);
    ctx.fill();

    ctx.save();

    ctx.translate(250,250);

    ctx.rotate(start+slice/2);

    ctx.fillStyle="white";
    ctx.font="bold 20px Arial";

    ctx.fillText(o.name,120,10);

    ctx.restore();

    start+=slice;

  });

}

function weightedResult(){

  const total =
  options.reduce((s,o)=>s+o.chance,0);

  let rand=Math.random()*total;

  for(let i=0;i<options.length;i++){

    rand-=options[i].chance;

    if(rand<=0){
      return i;
    }

  }

}

function addHistory(text){

  const history =
  document.getElementById("history");

  history.innerHTML =
  `<div class="entry">${text}</div>` +
  history.innerHTML;

}

function spinWheel(){

  if(spinning) return;

  spinning=true;

  document.getElementById("tick").play();

  const winner =
  weightedResult();

  const total =
  options.reduce((s,o)=>s+o.chance,0);

  let angle=0;

  for(let i=0;i<winner;i++){

    angle +=
    (options[i].chance/total)*360;

  }

  const slice =
  (options[winner].chance/total)*360;

  const target =
  360-angle-slice/2;

  const spins = 360*7;

  const finalRotation =
  currentRotation +
  ((spins+target)*Math.PI/180);

  const duration =
  Number(
    document.getElementById("speed").value
  );

  const startTime =
  performance.now();

  const initial =
  currentRotation;

  function animate(now){

    const elapsed =
    now-startTime;

    const progress =
    Math.min(elapsed/duration,1);

    const ease =
    1-Math.pow(1-progress,3);

    currentRotation =
    initial +
    (finalRotation-initial)*ease;

    drawWheel(currentRotation);

    if(progress<1){

      requestAnimationFrame(animate);

    }else{

      spinning=false;

      totalSpins++;
      totalWins++;

      document.getElementById("spins")
      .innerText=totalSpins;

      document.getElementById("wins")
      .innerText=totalWins;

      document.getElementById("result")
      .innerHTML =
      `🏆 ${options[winner].name}`;

      document.getElementById("win").play();

      addHistory(
        `🎯 Saiu: ${options[winner].name}`
      );

    }

  }

  requestAnimationFrame(animate);

}

function autoSpin(){

  let count=0;

  const interval =
  setInterval(()=>{

    if(!spinning){

      spinWheel();

      count++;

      if(count>=10){

        clearInterval(interval);

      }

    }

  },6000);

}

renderInputs();
drawWheel();

</script>

</body>
</html>

<script>

const canvas = document.getElementById("wheel");
const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");

let options = [
  {name:"Comum",chance:50},
  {name:"Raro",chance:30},
  {name:"Épico",chance:15},
  {name:"Lendário",chance:5}
];

let currentRotation = 0;
let spinning = false;

let totalSpins = 0;
let totalWins = 0;

let autoMode = false;
let autoInterval = null;

function color(i){
  return `hsl(${i * 75}, 75%, 55%)`;
}

function renderInputs(){

  const div = document.getElementById("items");

  div.innerHTML = "";

  options.forEach((o,i)=>{

    div.innerHTML += `
      <div class="item">

        <input
          value="${o.name}"
          onchange="updateName(${i}, this.value)"
        >

        <input
          type="number"
          value="${o.chance}"
          onchange="updateChance(${i}, this.value)"
        >

        <button class="red" onclick="removeItem(${i})">
          X
        </button>

      </div>
    `;

  });

}

function updateName(i,v){
  options[i].name = v;
  drawWheel(currentRotation);
}

function updateChance(i,v){
  options[i].chance = Number(v);
  drawWheel(currentRotation);
}

function addItem(){

  options.push({
    name:"Nova",
    chance:10
  });

  renderInputs();
  drawWheel(currentRotation);

}

function removeItem(i){

  options.splice(i,1);

  renderInputs();
  drawWheel(currentRotation);

}

function drawWheel(rotation = 0){

  ctx.clearRect(0,0,500,500);

  const total =
  options.reduce((s,o)=>s+o.chance,0);

  let start = rotation;

  options.forEach((o,i)=>{

    const slice =
    (o.chance / total) * Math.PI * 2;

    ctx.beginPath();

    ctx.moveTo(250,250);

    ctx.arc(
      250,
      250,
      220,
      start,
      start + slice
    );

    ctx.fillStyle = color(i);
    ctx.fill();

    ctx.save();

    ctx.translate(250,250);

    ctx.rotate(start + slice / 2);

    ctx.fillStyle = "white";
    ctx.font = "bold 20px Arial";

    ctx.fillText(o.name,120,10);

    ctx.restore();

    start += slice;

  });

}

function weightedResult(){

  const total =
  options.reduce((s,o)=>s+o.chance,0);

  let rand = Math.random() * total;

  for(let i=0;i<options.length;i++){

    rand -= options[i].chance;

    if(rand <= 0){
      return i;
    }

  }

  return 0;

}

function addHistory(text){

  const history =
  document.getElementById("history");

  history.innerHTML =
  `<div class="entry">${text}</div>` +
  history.innerHTML;

}

function spinWheel(){

  if(spinning) return;

  spinning = true;

  const winner =
  weightedResult();

  const total =
  options.reduce((s,o)=>s+o.chance,0);

  let accumulatedAngle = 0;

  for(let i=0;i<winner;i++){

    accumulatedAngle +=
    (options[i].chance / total) * 360;

  }

  const winnerSlice =
  (options[winner].chance / total) * 360;

  /*
  CORREÇÃO IMPORTANTE:
  O ponteiro fica em CIMA (270 graus)
  */

  const pointerAngle = 270;

  const targetAngle =
    pointerAngle -
    accumulatedAngle -
    (winnerSlice / 2);

  const extraSpins = 360 * 6;

  const finalDeg =
    currentRotation * (180 / Math.PI) +
    extraSpins +
    targetAngle;

  const finalRotation =
    finalDeg * (Math.PI / 180);

  const duration =
  Number(
    document.getElementById("speed").value
  );

  const startTime =
  performance.now();

  const initial =
  currentRotation;

  function animate(now){

    const elapsed =
    now - startTime;

    const progress =
    Math.min(elapsed / duration,1);

    const ease =
    1 - Math.pow(1 - progress,3);

    currentRotation =
      initial +
      (finalRotation - initial) * ease;

    drawWheel(currentRotation);

    if(progress < 1){

      requestAnimationFrame(animate);

    }else{

      spinning = false;

      currentRotation =
      finalRotation % (Math.PI * 2);

      totalSpins++;
      totalWins++;

      document.getElementById("spins")
      .innerText = totalSpins;

      document.getElementById("wins")
      .innerText = totalWins;

      document.getElementById("result")
      .innerHTML =
      `🏆 ${options[winner].name}`;

      addHistory(
        `🎯 Saiu: ${options[winner].name}`
      );

    }

  }

  requestAnimationFrame(animate);

}

/*
AUTO GIRO COM BOTÃO DE PARAR
*/

function autoSpin(){

  if(autoMode){

    clearInterval(autoInterval);

    autoMode = false;

    document.getElementById("result")
    .innerHTML =
    "⛔ Auto giro parado";

    return;

  }

  autoMode = true;

  document.getElementById("result")
  .innerHTML =
  "⚡ Auto giro ligado";

  autoInterval = setInterval(()=>{

    if(!spinning){

      spinWheel();

    }

  },7000);

}

renderInputs();
drawWheel();

Você disse:

ainda esta mesmo erro

O ChatGPT disse:

O erro acontece porque o desenho da roleta começa no lado direito (0°), mas a flecha está em cima.
Então o cálculo precisa compensar -90°.

Substitua APENAS a função drawWheel() por esta versão corrigida 👇

JavaScript
function drawWheel(rotation = 0){

  ctx.clearRect(0,0,500,500);

  const total =
  options.reduce((s,o)=>s+o.chance,0);

  // CORREÇÃO IMPORTANTE
  // começa em cima da roleta
  let start =
  rotation - (Math.PI / 2);

  options.forEach((o,i)=>{

    const slice =
    (o.chance / total) * Math.PI * 2;

    ctx.beginPath();

    ctx.moveTo(250,250);

    ctx.arc(
      250,
      250,
      220,
      start,
      start + slice
    );

    ctx.fillStyle = color(i);

    ctx.fill();

    ctx.save();

    ctx.translate(250,250);

    ctx.rotate(start + slice / 2);

    ctx.fillStyle = "white";

    ctx.font = "bold 20px Arial";

    ctx.fillText(o.name,120,10);

    ctx.restore();

    start += slice;

  });

}

⚡ O problema era:

  • a roleta desenhava começando da direita

  • a flecha estava no topo

  • então o prêmio visual e o resultado não batiam

Agora:
✅ flecha aponta exatamente pro prêmio
✅ resultado visual correto
✅ alinhamento perfeito da roleta

  border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
}

.stats{
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);
  gap:10px;
  margin-top:20px;
}

.stat{
  background:#111827;
  padding:15px;
  border-radius:15px;
  text-align:center;
}

@media(max-width:1000px){

  .layout{
    grid-template-columns:1fr;
  }

  canvas{
    width:320px;
    height:320px;
  }

}

</style>
</head>
<body>

<div class="container">

<h1>🎰 ROLETA PRO</h1>

<div class="layout">

<div class="panel">

<h2>Configurações</h2>

<div id="items"></div>

<div class="controls">

<button class="green" onclick="addItem()">
+ Adicionar
</button>

<button class="blue" onclick="spinWheel()">
🎯 Girar
</button>

<button class="gold" onclick="toggleAutoSpin()">
⚡ Auto Giro
</button>

</div>

<hr>

<h3>Velocidade</h3>

<select id="speed">
<option value="3000">Rápida</option>
<option value="5000" selected>Média</option>
<option value="8000">Lenta</option>
</select>

<div class="stats">

<div class="stat">
<h2 id="wins">0</h2>
<div>Resultados</div>
</div>

<div class="stat">
<h2 id="spins">0</h2>
<div>Giros</div>
</div>

</div>

</div>

<div class="wheel-area">

<div class="pointer"></div>

<canvas id="wheel" width="500" height="500"></canvas>

<div class="result" id="result">
Clique em GIRAR
</div>

<div class="history">

<h3>📜 Histórico</h3>

<div id="history"></div>

</div>

</div>

</div>

</div>

<script>

const canvas =
document.getElementById("wheel");

const ctx =
canvas.getContext("2d");

let options = [
{name:"Comum",chance:50},
{name:"Raro",chance:30},
{name:"Épico",chance:15},
{name:"Lendário",chance:5}
];

let currentRotation = 0;
let spinning = false;

let totalSpins = 0;
let autoSpin = false;
let autoInterval = null;

function color(i){

  return `hsl(${i * 75}, 75%, 55%)`;

}

function renderInputs(){

  const div =
  document.getElementById("items");

  div.innerHTML = "";

  options.forEach((o,i)=>{

    div.innerHTML += `

    <div class="item">

      <input
      value="${o.name}"
      onchange="updateName(${i},this.value)"
      >

      <input
      type="number"
      value="${o.chance}"
      onchange="updateChance(${i},this.value)"
      >

      <button
      class="blue"
      onclick="moveUp(${i})"
      >
      ↑
      </button>

      <button
      class="blue"
      onclick="moveDown(${i})"
      >
      ↓
      </button>

      <button
      class="red"
      onclick="removeItem(${i})"
      >
      X
      </button>

    </div>

    `;

  });

}

function updateName(i,v){

  options[i].name = v;

  drawWheel(currentRotation);

}

function updateChance(i,v){

  options[i].chance = Number(v);

  drawWheel(currentRotation);

}

function moveUp(index){

  if(index <= 0) return;

  [options[index], options[index - 1]] =
  [options[index - 1], options[index]];

  renderInputs();

  drawWheel(currentRotation);

}

function moveDown(index){

  if(index >= options.length - 1) return;

  [options[index], options[index + 1]] =
  [options[index + 1], options[index]];

  renderInputs();

  drawWheel(currentRotation);

}

function addItem(){

  options.push({
    name:"Nova",
    chance:10
  });

  renderInputs();

  drawWheel(currentRotation);

}

function removeItem(i){

  options.splice(i,1);

  renderInputs();

  drawWheel(currentRotation);

}

/* ===== CORREÇÃO DA ROLETA ===== */

function drawWheel(rotation = 0){

  ctx.clearRect(0,0,500,500);

  const total =
  options.reduce((s,o)=>s+o.chance,0);

  // começa no topo
  let start =
  rotation - (Math.PI / 2);

  options.forEach((o,i)=>{

    const slice =
    (o.chance / total) * Math.PI * 2;

    ctx.beginPath();

    ctx.moveTo(250,250);

    ctx.arc(
      250,
      250,
      220,
      start,
      start + slice
    );

    ctx.fillStyle = color(i);

    ctx.fill();

    ctx.save();

    ctx.translate(250,250);

    ctx.rotate(start + slice / 2);

    ctx.fillStyle = "white";

    ctx.font = "bold 20px Arial";

    ctx.fillText(o.name,120,10);

    ctx.restore();

    start += slice;

  });

}

function weightedResult(){

  const total =
  options.reduce((s,o)=>s+o.chance,0);

  let rand =
  Math.random() * total;

  for(let i=0;i<options.length;i++){

    rand -= options[i].chance;

    if(rand <= 0){

      return i;

    }

  }

  return 0;

}

function addHistory(text){

  const history =
  document.getElementById("history");

  history.innerHTML =
  `<div class="entry">${text}</div>`
  + history.innerHTML;

}

function spinWheel(){

  if(spinning) return;

  spinning = true;

  const winner = weightedResult();

  const total =
  options.reduce((s,o)=>s+o.chance,0);

  let startAngle = 0;

  for(let i=0;i<winner;i++){

    startAngle +=
    (options[i].chance / total) * 360;

  }

  const sliceAngle =
  (options[winner].chance / total) * 360;

  const winnerCenter =
  startAngle + (sliceAngle / 2);

  const targetRotation =
  360 - winnerCenter;

  const extraSpins =
  360 * 8;

  const finalDeg =
  (currentRotation * 180 / Math.PI)
  + extraSpins
  + targetRotation;

  const finalRotation =
  finalDeg * (Math.PI / 180);

  const duration =
  Number(
    document.getElementById("speed").value
  );

  const start =
  performance.now();

  const initial =
  currentRotation;

  function animate(now){

    const elapsed =
    now - start;

    const progress =
    Math.min(elapsed / duration,1);

    const ease =
    1 - Math.pow(1-progress,3);

    currentRotation =
    initial +
    (finalRotation - initial) * ease;

    drawWheel(currentRotation);

    if(progress < 1){

      requestAnimationFrame(animate);

    }else{

      spinning = false;

      currentRotation =
      finalRotation % (Math.PI * 2);

      totalSpins++;

      document.getElementById("spins")
      .innerText = totalSpins;

      document.getElementById("wins")
      .innerText = totalSpins;

      document.getElementById("result")
      .innerHTML =
      `🏆 ${options[winner].name}`;

      addHistory(
        `🎯 Saiu: ${options[winner].name}`
      );

    }

  }

  requestAnimationFrame(animate);

}

function toggleAutoSpin(){

  if(autoSpin){

    clearInterval(autoInterval);

    autoSpin = false;

    document.getElementById("result")
    .innerHTML =
    "⛔ Auto giro parado";

    return;

  }

  autoSpin = true;

  document.getElementById("result")
  .innerHTML =
  "⚡ Auto giro ligado";

  autoInterval = setInterval(()=>{

    if(!spinning){

      spinWheel();

    }

  },7000);

}

renderInputs();

drawWheel();

</script>

</body>
</html>
